//: Copy to proctor.json (gitignored) and point the routes at your gateway. nb: the host binary and its config. agents: where each vendor agent's model calls go (its base URL's host is the only name its container may reach): Claude Code an Anthropic route, Codex and Qwen Code an OpenAI-dialect one, the key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY of Harbor's process. harbor.uv: the uv that runs a suite's pinned Harbor; harbor.engine: the container engine Harbor drives, docker (the default) or podman (which needs `systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket`, docker-compose v2 behind `podman compose`, and unqualified-search-registries = ["docker.io"] in ~/.config/containers/registries.conf; see the README); harbor.nb: nb's self-contained linux-x64 publish (`dotnet publish nb.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained -o artifacts/linux-x64` in nb's repository), the same nb as nb.path, which an arm with agent nb runs in its image. judges: the endpoints the model checks call at grade time, by wire shape. ${VAR} references in endpoint and api_key resolve from the environment when `grade` (judges) or `run` (agents) needs them: LLM_GATEWAY is the base URL of an OpenAI-dialect gateway, LLM_GATEWAY_KEY its key; the paths below are the routes this suite expects it to serve.
